INTRODUCTION: A Software Engineer with production experience in full-stack development and data systems, building scalable web applications, internal tools, and data-driven solutions.
Focused on developing modern applications using Next.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, while expanding into data engineering through Python-based pipelines, SQL optimization, and Databricks.
ABOUT: I am a Software Engineer with hands-on experience building full-stack applications and data-driven systems using Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. I have contributed to production environments and developed real-world solutions, including administrative and management systems that support actual operational workflows. My work reflects a solid foundation in software engineering principles, database design, and API-driven architectures, with growing exposure to data pipelines and analytics-focused systems.

Throughout my career, I have taken on roles such as Systems Engineer II, Systems Analyst, and Full-Stack Developer, where I designed and delivered systems end-to-end—translating business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions. These experiences strengthened my ability to work across the full development lifecycle, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver reliable results in production environments.

I am focused on growing as a Software Engineer with strengths in full-stack development while expanding into data engineering. I work with technologies such as Python, SQL, and Databricks to build and optimize data pipelines, and I aim to contribute to systems that combine application development with data-driven insights. I value clean architecture, continuous learning, and building systems that are both practical and scalable.

Beyond my professional work, I value faith, family, and community as core foundations. I serve as a Lead Guitarist at Hills of Glory Mabalacat and stay actively involved in fellowship and discipleship. These commitments shape my discipline, consistency, and long-term perspective in both my personal life and engineering career.
STORY: My path to becoming a web developer began not with a single line of code, but with a question I kept asking in every role: "How can we make this system work better?"

My career started in the world of data and analysis. At STRIDE Consulting, I worked on complex traffic simulations, installing hardware in the field and transforming raw data into clear, actionable reports using R. This experience taught me a fundamental truth: every technical system exists to serve a real-world need. I learned to see the bigger picture, from hardware setup to final data visualization.

That big-picture thinking is what pulled me toward web development. I wanted to build the interfaces and tools that people actually use. I dove in headfirst, teaching myself modern front-end technologies. This led me to Citrof Group, where I had to rapidly master the T3 Stack (Next.js, TypeScript, tRPC) to contribute to live projects. It was a challenging and exhilarating confirmation that I could not only learn quickly but also deliver tangible value.

Driven by a desire to own a project from concept to launch, I took on a volunteer role as a Project Lead Developer at Hills of Glory church. Starting with just an idea, I taught myself the TALL Stack (Laravel, Livewire) and led a small team to build a full church management system. This experience was pivotal—it showed me the power of technology to build community and solve specific organizational problems.
Most recently, as a Systems Engineer at La Rose Noire, I focused on creating internal web systems to streamline operations, deepening my practical PHP expertise.
GOALS: To secure a long-term role as a Full-Stack Web Developer within a stable team that values clean code, mentorship, and sustainable growth.
To deepen my expertise in a focused technology stack such as Next.js or Laravel while contributing meaningfully to production codebases.
To leverage my adaptability and quick learning skills to take on increasing responsibilities and complex projects over time.

Today, my focus is clear. I am seeking to channel this blend of analytical thinking, rapid learning, and full-stack project experience into a dedicated role. I want to join a collaborative engineering team where I can deepen my mastery of a modern stack like Next.js or Laravel, contribute to meaningful products, and grow alongside colleagues who value clean, impactful code.

I believe great development is about understanding the "why" behind the "what you're building." If you're looking for a developer who combines technical adaptability with a systems-thinking approach, I'd love to connect.
OUTSIDE_WORK: I serve as the Lead Guitarist and a Music Theory Mentor in my church's Music and Arts Ministry.
This role allows me to blend technical skill with spiritual service—from crafting worship setlists and teaching foundational theory to fostering fellowship within our creative community.
I deeply value the unique connection between creative expression and spiritual growth that this ministry nurtures.
